messages:
Alex Chen: incident-bot fired: PagerDuty alert PD-4521 - inference-runtime-high-latency
incident-bot: Escalation policy 'SRE 24/7' triggered, initial page sent to primary on-call
pagerduty-bot: Page sent to Alex Chen (primary) via phone/sms :phone:
Alex Chen: Acking. Looking into it now. @Maria if you have time can you watch customer impact dashboard?
Maria Gomez: On it. Checking per-customer error rates and request latencies.
Alex Chen: Root cause appears to be sustained KV cache thrash after a bad model rollout. Queue depth high on gpu-pool-3.
Jordan Lee: I just got a PD SMS, haven't seen the alert in Slack until now. Did escalation fire?
pagerduty-bot: No ack from primary within 2m, secondary escalation to Jordan Lee fired.
Jordan Lee: Acking now. Jumping into the node and attaching logs.
Alex Chen: Thanks. I'm temporarily redirecting traffic to standby pool (gpu-pool-1) via routing policy.
Alex Chen: command: `redwoodctl route update --pool gpu-pool-1 --weight 70` — applying, will monitor.
incident-bot: automatic runbook step triggered: increase concurrency limit on pool1 by 20%.
Maria Gomez: Customer impact: about 3% of requests from org:partner-pro have timeouts > 5s. No 5xx spike yet. Logging shows repeated KV cache misses.
Jordan Lee: tail logs: `oom on worker 7` then reconnect loop. Looks like worker OOM combined with slow GC on quantized-model-2.
Alex Chen: Spawning extra worker on pool1, setting `max_tokens_batch=128` lower to reduce mem pressure.
Alex Chen: command: `redwoodctl scale --pool gpu-pool-1 --workers +2`
ops-oncall: Manager escalation: no ack from secondary in policy window, escalating to oncall-manager (Lina).
Alex Chen: I'm seeing lat drop from 1.2s to 320ms after reroute and worker add. Still monitoring for stability.
Maria Gomez: Noting customers impacted list: partner-pro, mobile-app-prod. Sending heads-up to CS ops with draft message.
Jordan Lee: I'll run `strace` and capture heap profile, posting link: https://files.redwood/snapshots/heap-1712345678
pagerduty-bot: Escalation policy 'SRE 24/7' notified manager Lina Park (oncall-manager). Call attempt failed — left voicemail.
Lina Park: I'm awake, taking over escalation. Please add me to call bridge.
Alex Chen: Adding bridge: Zoom ID 890-XXXX. Invites sent.
Alex Chen: Plan: 1) keep routing to pool1, 2) roll back quantized-model-2 to model-2-v1, 3) scale pool to absorb remaining traffic.
Lina Park: Approve rollback and scale. If rollback doesn't reduce OOMs in 5m, move to fallback model-1-compat.
Maria Gomez: Updating incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-2178
Alex Chen: Rolled back model: `deployed model quantized-model-2 -> model-2-v1` — command output: success.
Jordan Lee: After rollback, OOMs stopped. tail shows stable worker pool.
Maria Gomez: Customer impact update: timeouts reduced to <0.5% in last 5m. No open customer tickets yet.
Lina Park: Great. Stand down escalations; confirm no further auto-escalation. Keep monitoring 30m.
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated; will auto-close after 30m of stable metrics.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. Filing postmortem draft.
Maria Gomez: Adding action items: improve canary rollout checks for quantized models, add alert for sustained KV miss rate.
Jordan Lee: I'll own the heap profiling runbook and add to playbook.
Alex Chen: End.
